'''Kurse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected the Empire, joining with the Revanite forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Kurse and his fellow Revanites tried to stop a strike team from reaching [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[temple of Sacrifice artifact]], but were defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Kurse appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
